<MethodEndpoint

  path={"/api/wiki/pages"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



The wiki overview, search and "recently updated" in one list: pages
you can see in one family, most recently edited first,
cursor-paginated. Returns summaries (a plain-text `excerpt`, no
`content`). `q` is a case-insensitive search over title, category
and content.
